constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES runs(run_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES capability_tasks(task_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (current_task_id, session_id, capability_id) REFERENCES capability_tasks(task_id, session_id, capability_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (last_run_id) REFERENCES runs(run_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES runs(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CHECK ((((status = 'pending'::text) AND (resume_payload IS NULL) AND (resume_request_id IS NULL) AND (resume_request_fingerprint IS NULL) AND (resumed_at IS NULL) AND (cancelled_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'resumed'::text) AND (resume_payload IS NOT NULL) AND (resume_request_id IS NOT NULL) AND (resume_request_fingerprint IS NOT NULL) AND (resumed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (cancelled_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'cancelled'::text) AND (resume_payload IS NULL) AND (resume_request_id IS NULL) AND (resume_request_fingerprint IS NULL) AND (resumed_at IS NULL) AND (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES runs(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

comments.comment: 保存 Capability 外部副作用操作的幂等账本状态，关联 Run、Invocation 和 Task；不保存业务响应载荷。
保存每个 Session 与 Capability 当前选中的 active Capability Task 指针；没有当前 Task 时不保留记录。
保存 Capability Task 的生命周期、所属 Session 与 Capability、状态 Schema 版本及最近一次 Run/Invocation 投影；不保存业务载荷。
保存用户对已完成 AI 回答的最终点赞或点踩值；session_id 用于会话删除时清理。
保存 Run 的中断及恢复幂等投影，包括中断状态、恢复输入和恢复请求标识；每个 Run 同时最多一个待处理中断。
保存每次普通消息或重新生成请求的持久执行生命周期、幂等与恢复投影；是 Run 状态的 PostgreSQL 权威数据源。
保存 Run 的持久公开事件和内部事件，按 Run 序号记录执行、Interrupt、Capability Invocation 与 Task 生命周期投影；不保存瞬时消息增量或完整 AI 消息正文。
保存 Session 业务元数据；每条记录标识一个固定用户的会话，并作为该会话业务数据与删除流程的根记录。
保存固定用户对 Capability 的显式允许或拒绝记录；无记录按拒绝处理，记录不随 Session 删除。

保存每次普通消息或重新生成请求的持久执行生命周期、幂等与恢复投影；是 Run 状态的 PostgreSQL 权威数据源。
保存 Run 的持久公开事件和内部事件，按 Run 序号记录执行、Interrupt、Capability Invocation 与 Task 生命周期投影；不保存瞬时消息增量或完整 AI 消息正文。

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES runs(run_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES capability_tasks(task_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (current_task_id, session_id, capability_id) REFERENCES capability_tasks(task_id, session_id, capability_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (last_run_id) REFERENCES runs(run_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(session_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK ((((status = 'active'::text) AND (ended_at IS NULL)) OR ((status <> 'active'::text) AND (ended_at IS NOT NULL))))
PRIMARY KEY (thread_id, checkpoint_ns, checkpoint_id, task_id, idx)
FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES runs(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CHECK ((((status = 'pending'::text) AND (resume_payload IS NULL) AND (resume_request_id IS NULL) AND (resume_request_fingerprint IS NULL) AND (resumed_at IS NULL) AND (cancelled_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'resumed'::text) AND (resume_payload IS NOT NULL) AND (resume_request_id IS NOT NULL) AND (resume_request_fingerprint IS NOT NULL) AND (resumed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (cancelled_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'cancelled'::text) AND (resume_payload IS NULL) AND (resume_request_id IS NULL) AND (resume_request_fingerprint IS NULL) AND (resumed_at IS NULL) AND (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES runs(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX capability_operations_idempotency_key_key ON public.capability_operations USING btree (idempotency_key)
CREATE INDEX capability_operations_invocation_idx ON public.capability_operations USING btree (run_id, invocation_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX capability_operations_pkey ON public.capability_operations USING btree (operation_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX capability_operations_run_id_invocation_id_operation_key_key ON public.capability_operations USING btree (run_id, invocation_id, operation_key)
CREATE INDEX capability_operations_task_idx ON public.capability_operations USING btree (task_id, updated_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX capability_task_contexts_current_task_id_key ON public.capability_task_contexts USING btree (current_task_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX capability_task_contexts_pkey ON public.capability_task_contexts USING btree (session_id, capability_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX capability_tasks_context_key ON public.capability_tasks USING btree (task_id, session_id, capability_id)
CREATE INDEX capability_tasks_last_run_idx ON public.capability_tasks USING btree (last_run_id) WHERE (last_run_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX capability_tasks_lookup_idx ON public.capability_tasks USING btree (session_id, capability_id, status, updated_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX capability_tasks_pkey ON public.capability_tasks USING btree (task_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX checkpoint_blobs_pkey ON public.checkpoint_blobs USING btree (thread_id, checkpoint_ns, channel, version)
CREATE INDEX checkpoint_blobs_thread_id_idx ON public.checkpoint_blobs USING btree (thread_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX checkpoint_migrations_pkey ON public.checkpoint_migrations USING btree (v)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX checkpoint_writes_pkey ON public.checkpoint_writes USING btree (thread_id, checkpoint_ns, checkpoint_id, task_id, idx)
CREATE INDEX checkpoint_writes_thread_id_idx ON public.checkpoint_writes USING btree (thread_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX checkpoints_pkey ON public.checkpoints USING btree (thread_id, checkpoint_ns, checkpoint_id)
CREATE INDEX checkpoints_thread_id_idx ON public.checkpoints USING btree (thread_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX message_feedback_pkey ON public.message_feedback USING btree (user_id, message_id)
CREATE INDEX message_feedback_session_id_idx ON public.message_feedback USING btree (session_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX run_interrupts_one_pending_per_run_idx ON public.run_interrupts USING btree (run_id) WHERE (status = 'pending'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX run_interrupts_pkey ON public.run_interrupts USING btree (run_id, interrupt_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX run_interrupts_resume_request_id_idx ON public.run_interrupts USING btree (resume_request_id) WHERE (resume_request_id IS NOT NULL)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runs_one_active_per_session_idx ON public.runs USING btree (session_id) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'running'::text, 'recovering'::text, 'interrupted'::text, 'cancel_requested'::text]))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runs_pkey ON public.runs USING btree (run_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runs_request_id_key ON public.runs USING btree (request_id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runtime_events_one_terminal_per_run_idx ON public.runtime_events USING btree (run_id) WHERE (event_type = ANY (ARRAY['run.completed'::text, 'run.cancelled'::text, 'run.failed'::text]))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runtime_events_pkey ON public.runtime_events USING btree (event_id)
CREATE INDEX runtime_events_public_replay_idx ON public.runtime_events USING btree (run_id, seq) WHERE (visibility = 'public'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runtime_events_run_seq_key ON public.runtime_events USING btree (run_id, seq)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sessions_pkey ON public.sessions USING btree (session_id)
CREATE INDEX sessions_user_updated_id_idx ON public.sessions USING btree (user_id, updated_at DESC, session_id DESC)
CREATE INDEX user_capability_permissions_lookup_idx ON public.user_capability_permissions USING btree (capability_id, allowed)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX user_capability_permissions_pkey ON public.user_capability_permissions USING btree (user_id, capability_id)
